work.title: The Elements of Dynamic Symmetry & Dynamic Symmetry: The Greek Vase
work.copyright_attestation: 100% Public Domain worldwide and in the United States. This Digital Scriptorium edition derives exclusively from Jay Hambidge's 1919–1920 Yale University Press publications: The Diagonal, Vol. I, Nos. 1–12 (1919–1920, LCCN 20005786), and Dynamic Symmetry: The Greek Vase (1920, LCCN 20017904). Both imprints entered the US public domain by statutory expiration and absence of post-1928 copyright barriers.

sources.author: Jay Hambidge (ed.)

sources.notes: Original 1919–1920 Yale University Press serial publication containing Jay Hambidge's 'The Elements of Dynamic Symmetry' lessons (later collected posthumously in book form in 1926), including sunflower phyllotaxis (after A. H. Church), root rectangles (sqrt(1) to sqrt(5)), reciprocal rectangles, and the whirling-square golden rectangle.

sources.notes: First book-length monograph by Jay Hambidge (Yale University Press, 1920), establishing static vs. dynamic symmetry, leaf-distribution and shell spirals, Euclidean commensurability in square (Book X), and root-five / whirling-square harmonic analysis.
